result:
Here is a 259 word free-form piece:

The leaves rustle softly in the gentle breeze, and a few drift down to the forest floor, adding to the thick carpet of green, brown, and gold below the towering trees. Sunlight filters through the canopy, dappling the ground with patterns of light and shadow. A small stream gurgles its way over the rocks, its clear water reflecting the sky above. 

The air is filled with the songs of birds - a robin's cheerful warble, the melodic trill of a wood thrush, the cawing of crows in the distance. Occasionally the peaceful quiet is broken by the chittering of a squirrel or the buzzing of a bee as it darts from flower to flower. The earthy scent of soil, moss, and decaying leaves mingles with the floral fragrance of the wildflowers blooming all around.

It is a tranquil, rejuvenating scene, a haven of natural beauty in the midst of the bustling modern world. Here, time seems to slow, and one can simply be present, senses attuned to the rhythms and textures of the living, breathing forest. The troubles and stresses of daily life fade into the background as the mind becomes absorbed in the wonder of this verdant, vibrant oasis. It is a place to find solace, to reconnect with the essence of what it means to be human - immersed in the natural world, awed by its majesty and complexity. In this sanctuary, the soul can rest and the spirit can be renewed.
